author: _Phyre
body:
Since my last map "BattleField" Went off the cliff, i decided to make a new one, an improved one, and amazing one... "Sentra", this is a map that i sorta based on Twilight, however there is only 2 trees,1 for each team. This is a 25v25 Map, with teams: Lime, and Blue. The only problem i have with it is... That i think the 2 layers in the middle where the fights should happen, are too small, However I tested it with some of my friends and i think it will be okay. Without further a due lets get into the links:

YML 

Images.......................Resource pack: Default 16x.

Download 

I really think this map looks good, i spent quite some time on it (I dont have a life :P, thats why i finished it a day after the Galloway map was released :P) So i hope you guys enjoy this map! And ye!

Rate: 1/10  2/10  3/10  4/10  5/10  6/10  7/10  8/10  9/10  10/10  Potato/Potato :)

***Make sure to check over the YML i might have missed something and needs tobe fixed, thank you!***
